caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure with a cone-shaped red hat that has black accents and appears worn or chipped at the top. The face of the figure is grayish with dark shadowing and highlights, featuring pronounced facial features such as a prominent nose, wide mouth, and large eyes. The figure wears a ruffled, white collar with red accents, and a multicolored garment with vertical stripes in red, yellow, and blue, and a yellow button detail. The right arm is extended forward and bent at the elbow, colored brown and yellow, with the hand open. The left arm is held close to the body, colored in dark blue or black, and the forearm or hand is clenched into a fist. On the blue section of the garment, there is a yellow and red star-like emblem. The background is plain and beige, and the lower left corner includes the handwritten name "LEW TOWER."
title: Cast Iron Toy Bank: Humpty Dumpty
